blocks.text: Take care of your hair with the Gimme Beauty Chill Curl Heatless Styling Set. We're giving "bedhead" a whole new meaning. These bendable rods let you wake up to soft, bouncy waves without the heat or hassle. Designed to be gentle and prevent tension, this heatless hair styling tool features breathable, soft, and cooling material for effortless overnight styling.

Achieve salon-quality curls without using heat with this flex rod. This hair care essential is the perfect addition to your nighttime routine to protect from hair breakage. Designed for overnight comfort, this set comes with a flexible, pillow-soft curling rod, two ultra-smooth scrunchies, and a matching claw clip so you can just wrap and rest easy.

At Gimme Beauty, we are a hair care brand with a mission to create a range of products that work for all hair types. Knowing hair solutions are not one size fits all. Each of you are unique, your hair care should be too. We celebrate your individual beauty and aim to elevate it with disruptive invention. Think of us as your go-to BFF for hair care. We'll give you the best advice, hype you up, and always make you feel comfortable in your own skin.

We lean into the sisterhood created by our mutual experiences with hair. Where other beauty brands might value exclusivity or eliteness, we are all about inclusion and accessibility. Our goal is to amplify hair confidence, because we believe confident women are unstoppable.
